diagnosis.root_cause: The positive/negative event contract used post-core progress to define launch/no-launch, and v1 supplied the same post-core displacement as a feature. This is causal at the delayed decision time but it is not evidence of global pre-launch morphology learning.

disposition: Do not apply v1 to L1 candidates or train downstream L2. Preserve artifacts as a failed attempt. V2 moves the L1.5 right edge to core_end_i and excludes every post-core candle.
